intro.text: A man who asks Spook to save his sister from Quellion's witch-hunt.

items.text: After playing cards with Durn, asked Spook to rescue his sister, taken in Quellion's witch-hunt because their father had been a nobleman. At Spook's direction he and some friends dug up the remains from a burned house and found nine skulls for ten victims, showing Spook that the tenth had been secretly taken away for being a Misting.
